summary: Verified the Pet mini-game cooldown fix on web. All 8 cases pass: Bath cooldown is now applied regardless of dismissal path (X close, Done button, or 1.5s auto-timer) and the reward is committed exactly once (spread between the three paths = 2s). Feed and Play behave the same via X close. Early-exit before completion correctly applies NO cooldown. Disabled tiles correctly refuse to reopen the room.
critical_code_review_comments: useComplete() correctly uses firedRef to guard against double-firing of onComplete. The reward commits once at celebrate() and the 1.5s timer only closes. Verified empirically: 3 completion paths produced the same server cooldown within 2s (noise is wall-clock, not a double-reward).
Pet.jsx cleanly separates onComplete (POST /api/pet/{action}) from onClose (unmount room). Good contract.
Minor nit (not blocking): FOOD_RULES has duplicate key 'horse' / 'pony' entries (bunny→carrot works; unicorn/horse rule is unreachable for a horse). Non-functional.
seed_data_creation: None. Used founder account and POST /api/admin/users/{id}/refresh-pet between runs to clear cooldowns.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pet mini-games (feed/bath/play) are stable. Direct DOM .click() via page.evaluate reliably bypasses the preview's 'Get the app' PWA banner for mobile-viewport tests. The CareRoom reward now commits inside useComplete.celebrate(), not in finishCare — do not reintroduce the old finishCare path.
